about: Modwerk source-only kitbank package for Digitone OS 1.44, compiled from sdk/digitone/modules/kitbank.

mods.title: Kit per bank
mods.summary: One kit per bank, like the Octatrack's parts: the 16 patterns of a bank play the kit of its first pattern, with per-pattern locks.
mods.description: KIT PER BANK in SETTINGS (off at power-on) gives the 16 patterns of a bank the kit of its first pattern (A01 for A01 to A16). Pattern changes inside a bank keep the sound, including queued changes, chains and song mode. Hold PTN and press YES to lock a pattern to its own copy of the sound. The switch and locks are saved with the project; old projects open with the switch off and play as stock.
mods.author: ZOGV
mods.on_unit: The author ran this exact build (core dn1 2.0a + kitbank 0.2.0-experimental, XX07) on a Digitone, OS 1.44 (2026-11-14) with a nine-step test list and reported that it worked. Reported as one statement: which steps were tried and for how long is not recorded.
